subject: Load - MEM to Olive Branch
body: Need this covered for tomorrow. Pick Harlow Foods Memphis TN 38118, ready 0800. Deliver Walmart DC 6047 Olive Branch MS. FCFS 0600-1400, no appt. 42,000 lbs dry, 26 pallets. $850 all in. Let me know.

body: What would you run Memphis to Little Rock for these days? Just trying to budget, nothing to move yet. 44k dry van.

subject: Tender 88213
body: PU: Gulfcoast Chem, 1400 Industrial Pkwy, Gulfport MS 39503. Appt 9/9 1000, hard appointment, they will turn you away if late. DEL: Cintas, Nashville TN 37210, appt 9/10 0700. 38,500 lbs. Hazmat placarded, UN1993 Class 3. Tanker endorsement not required, drums on pallets. Rate 1,950. Detention after 2 hrs at origin, $75/hr, must be noted on the BOL and approved by our dispatch in writing.

subject: same as yesterday
body: Same as the one I sent you yesterday but pickup Thursday instead. Everything else identical.

subject: 2 stops
body: Del Rio Textiles Southaven MS to two consignees. First stop Jackson TN, second stop Bowling Green KY. 31,000 total, roughly 60/40 split. Driver will need to break down the first stop by hand, no dock at Jackson, ground delivery. Pickup Friday AM. $2,400.

subject: Automatic reply: Out of Office
body: I am out of the office until Monday September 14 with limited access to email. For urgent matters contact the main line.

subject: Reefer load Memphis-Dallas
body: Monarch Beverage Memphis to our Dallas warehouse. 40,000 lbs, continuous reefer at 36F, temp recorder required. Load Monday. Receiver is our own DC so unload is quick. Rate 2,100 all in, this is an all-in rate and we do not pay accessorials, that has been our arrangement since we started.

subject: RE: Tender 88213
body: Following up - did the driver get the detention approved? We got the invoice and there's a 3 hour detention charge on it but nothing in writing from our side. Need the BOL notation before we can pay that.

subject: Hot load
body: Need a truck today. Pinnacle Auto Parts, Southaven, to the Nissan plant in Smyrna TN. Parts are for a line that is down. 8 pallets, 6,200 lbs. Plant receiving is strict, they have a 30 minute window and if you miss it you sit until they can work you in, sometimes the next shift. Whatever it costs.

subject: Load

subject: please disregard

subject: another one

subject: Furniture delivery

School has no loading dock, delivery is at the side entrance off the parking lot. Someone will need to help get it off the truck. Must be delivered after 3pm when students are gone. About 9,000 lbs. Can you do it Thursday?

subject: Memphis to Nashville
body: Straightforward one. Monarch Memphis to our Nashville depot, 38,000, load Tuesday 0700, deliver same day. They turn trucks in 45 minutes at both ends so no detention expected on this. 1,150.

subject: Container pull - BNSF Memphis

subject: Short pay notice 44219
body: We are short paying invoice 44219 by $200. The POD shows delivery on 9/12 but the tender required 9/11. Late delivery penalty per our agreement. Let me know if you dispute.

subject: Smyrna again
